query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[3] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:49:00) My children. Kingsley the kitchen in this house is not a barbecue pit. But I will allow the suya if you keep the smoke outside. Adaeze, chin chin is expected, do not arrive without it. God willing, I have a full house this year. Oby, are you joining us from Enugu via video? 🙏
[4] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:09:00) Ifeoma I totally forgot!! okay SO Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that 😭
[5] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:41:00) I am COMING 🙌🙌 I have the 24th off and my next shift is the 28th so I have four whole days. Mum I could actually eat an entire pot of jollof right now, hospital canteen rice is a hate crime
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:08:00) My children, your Aunty Oby is speaking wisdom. And nobody thought to ask whether I need any help with the cooking this year? You know I will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but I will remember who did not ask. 🙂
[7] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[8] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[9] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[10] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:29:00) okay so on it. I'll put together a running order: 1. Video call with Aunty Oby at 11am before food 2. Food from 2pm 3. Emeka's lot arriving by 12 based on his message. (no stress, I'll circulate it by Friday!) 😊
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze worries Nkechi is not eating properly due to gardening and asks if she is eating well.
[12] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze asks Nkechi not to bury the lede when sharing health news.
[13] (about=Chisom, core, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Chisom requests a small pot of egusi with stockfish for Ifeoma, which she would also eat.
[14] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka insists Nkechi is coming to Leeds and will collect her from Reading, making a weekend of it.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka will collect Nkechi from Reading for the Leeds gathering.
[16] (about=Kingsley, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Kingsley offers to drive Nkechi to her surgery and promises to visit Reading this month, putting it in his calendar.
[17] (about=Nkechi, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Nkechi notes nobody asked whether she needs help with cooking this year, and she will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but will remember who did not ask.
[18] (about=Nkechi, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Nkechi enjoys gardening as a hobby and prefers it to watching television.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Kingsley will bring suya and handle the meat, keeping smoke outside; Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff; Tobenna brings drinks; Ifeoma will have a fish dish (egusi with stockfish) prepared.
[20] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states Adaeze does the fund chasing every year and suggests Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility, as Adaeze should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
[21] (about=Obiageli, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Obiageli advises Nkechi to get a second opinion on medication changes and cites a family saying about keeping promises.
